title: COVID-19 pandemic
summary: Wuhan health authorities reported a pneumonia cluster on 31 December 2019; WHO declared an international emergency on 30 January 2020 and characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on 11 March. WHO estimates about 14.9 million excess deaths in 2020 and 2021 (range 13.3 to 16.6 million), well above reported deaths.

uncertainty.note: Start is the date of the first report to WHO. End is the close of the period covered by WHO's excess-death estimate, not an end of the pandemic; no opened source dates its end.

as_recorded.value: 31 Dec 2019 Wuhan Municipal Health Commission, China, reported a cluster of cases of pneumonia

where.modern_name: Wuhan, Hubei, China (first reported cluster; the pandemic was global)

importance.justification: A global pandemic that caused millions of deaths and reshaped health systems, economies and daily life.

numbers.note: Same WHO page gives at least 3 million excess deaths for 2020 (preliminary).
